projects.name: Chronicle.Domain
projects.purpose: Domain entities, value objects, invariants, Domain services, Domain events, system-neutral mechanics.
acceptanceCriteria: No EF Core, SQLite, provider SDK, UI, or Werewolf references.

projects.name: Chronicle.Contracts
projects.purpose: Versioned public and cross-boundary contracts, DTOs, identifiers, envelopes.

projects.name: Chronicle.RuleSets.Abstractions
projects.purpose: Rule Set descriptors, schemas, operation contracts, validation, compatibility, execution boundary.

projects.name: Chronicle.NarrativeIntelligence.Abstractions
projects.purpose: Provider-neutral Narrative Intelligence contracts and failure/capability models.

projects.name: Chronicle.Application
projects.purpose: Use cases, commands, queries, orchestration, ports, recovery, package selection and binding coordination.

projects.name: Chronicle.Infrastructure
projects.purpose: Generic infrastructure implementations, filesystem, time, randomness, hashing, archive primitives, platform services, package filesystem loading.
forbiddenDependencies: specific Rule Set implementations unless explicitly approved
acceptanceCriteria: Implements ports without becoming Application layer.

projects.name: Chronicle.Persistence.Sqlite
projects.purpose: EF Core SQLite persistence, mappings, migrations, repositories, transaction coordinator, recovery data.
acceptanceCriteria: Concrete persistence is named Chronicle.Persistence.Sqlite and owns migrations.

projects.name: Chronicle.NarrativeIntelligence.OpenAI
acceptanceCriteria: Provider SDK remains in adapter only.

projects.name: Chronicle.Presentation.Desktop
projects.purpose: Desktop presentation models, views, view models, navigation, accessibility, localization resources.
acceptanceCriteria: UI communicates through Application use cases/read models only.

projects.name: Chronicle.Desktop
projects.purpose: Composition root, startup, DI, configuration, migrations, logging, Safe Mode, desktop host.
allowedDependencies: required concrete implementation projects for composition
forbiddenDependencies: Domain or Application business logic ownership

projects.name: Chronicle.RuleSets.Werewolf
projects.purpose: First official Rule Set package source after transformation from documentation prototype evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Package source is distinct from docs prototype and has provenance controls.
